note: Road time and distance between coordinates, from OSRM (router.project-osrm.org, driving profile, table service), keyed by coordinates rounded to five decimals: pairs 'from>to' -> [seconds, metres]; snap 'point' -> metres from the input coordinate to the road. Written only by tools/build_routes.py. Fallback legs are never stored here. Delete an entry, or the file, to have it fetched again.
